title: ELECTRICAL-CONTENTS
summary: Contents of UPC 12 electrical: headlamps and their vacuum actuators, parking/side marker lamps and horns, forward lamp and engine wiring harnesses, battery and cables, headlamp aiming, vacuum hose routing (A1-A15); fuse panel, instrument cluster, gauges, I.P. harness, stop lamp switch, parking brake alarm, lamp monitors, access door switch (B1-B9); turn signal lever/horn cap, speedo & tach cables, back-up lamp switch, rear harness and tail/license lamps (C1-C6); wiring diagrams (D1-D8). A car drawing points to where each sheet applies.
notes: NOTE: Front of Dash Sealing-See UPC 1.
notes_internal: Drawing callouts also show B10 ('B1 THRU B10') and B11, which are not in the contents list (list ends at B9).
Revision date middle digit unreadable: '6-?-69'. Circled 1 at lower right of drawing area.
Multi-line titles joined with single spaces.
